Maya (Marketing): heads up — seeing an uptick in unassigned inbound leads this morning, hitting our 15m SLA in HubSpot.
Sam (SDR): yep noticed. some leads are stuck in enrichment state for >5m then fall through to unassigned.
Joel (RevOps): possible race between enrichment webhook and RR assignment. HubSpot webhook retries might be slow.
Karen (Growth): is this correlated with yesterday's enrichment model deploy?
Sam (SDR): timelines match. model v3.2 pushed ~02:10 UTC and enrichment queue spiked.
Joel (RevOps): quick mitigation: increase claim timeout to 25s and add a default-owner fallback for leads with enrichment older than 3m. should stop SLA breaches while we root cause.
Maya (Marketing): can we do that without touching product code? prefer HubSpot workflow change if possible.
Joel (RevOps): yep can do via workflow + webhook guard. patch I propose:
HubSpotBot: incoming webhook received: /workflows/assign-enriched -> status=queued
Joel (RevOps): ```
workflow: assign-enriched
conditions:
  - enrichment_state != "pending"
  - enrichment_age_seconds <= 180
actions:
  - route: round_robin
  - fallback_owner: sdr-default
  - increment: claim_heartbeat
```
Joel (RevOps): that adds the 3m guard and a fallback owner. also throttle the RR to avoid simultaneous claims.
Sam (SDR): fallback_owner = sdr-default ok by me. will that create duplicates?
Joel (RevOps): no duplicates — we mark as assigned on first successful claim. others get a fail and record.
Karen (Growth): do we need to alert when fallback hits? would like a slack ping if >5% of leads use fallback in 1h.
Maya (Marketing): yes, add alert. we need visibility for launch flows.
Joel (RevOps): will add a lightweight metric: fallback_rate and a PagerDuty if >10% for 30m.
DeployBot: deploy started by joel.revops on staging -> workflows/assign-enriched v2026-03-23T09:12Z
Maya (Marketing): ETA for production patch?
Joel (RevOps): can patch prod in 20m, plan: patch workflow -> short canary on 5% of traffic -> full rollout after 10m no errors.
Sam (SDR): shoutout: will monitor queue and claim latency, callout any weird owner mapping.
Karen (Growth): after patch, let's run a quick smoke: create 10 test leads with slow enrichment and confirm they fall to sdr-default after 3m.
Maya (Marketing): I'll coordinate the test and update the launch runbook. pls add the rollback steps in case something misroutes.
Joel (RevOps): rollback is just disabling fallback_owner and reverting workflow to previous revision. I'll put the commands in the runbook.
Maya (Marketing): perfect — thanks. :thumbsup:
Sam (SDR): lgtm. I'll be on watch for the next hour.
Joel (RevOps): rolling now. tagging @Karen for fallback metric alert thresholds.
Karen (Growth): got it. will stand by. :eyes:
DeployBot: deploy succeeded on production: workflows/assign-enriched v2026-03-23T09:34Z
Maya (Marketing): initial check — 8 test leads processed: 7 assigned by RR, 1 hit fallback after 3:05 and assigned to sdr-default. fallback_rate 12% (small sample).
Karen (Growth): sample size tiny but note the fallback. we'll keep an eye on 1h window.
Joel (RevOps): opening a follow-up ticket to root cause enrichment latency and to tune RR back to tighter TTL once enrichment issue fixed.
Maya (Marketing): thanks team — keeping this thread open for updates.
